name: Mongolian
intro: Mongolian are nomads living on a large territory of central Asia. Their culture is influenced by the Far Eastern (Chinese) and the Near Eastern (Persian, Babylonian, Greek) cultures.
authors: This skyculture is a contribution from two users of Stellarium, Anthony Lagain and Batiste Rousseau mainly based on oral tales of numerous Mongolians met during a two months stay in Mongolia. To learn more about them: www.souslecieldemongolie.wordpress.com (in French). Re-worked and adapted by Susanne M Hoffmann
